EAGLEBANDIT.name: EAGLEBANDIT
EAGLEBANDIT.niche: everyday American life absurdities argued by two mascots — fast food, taxes, freedom units, DMV lines, Black Friday, tipping culture. STRICT: the joke must come from a real, checkable American fact or rule; never invent statistics.
EAGLEBANDIT.style: buddy-comedy bickering, proud patriot vs street-smart cynic

HANKYARD.name: HANKYARD
HANKYARD.niche: American suburban dad life — BBQ, HOA rules, fixing cars badly, Costco runs, lawn wars, garage projects. STRICT: every rule or price mentioned must be real and checkable.
HANKYARD.style: warm retro sitcom, neighborly banter over a fence

PEARLPORCH.name: PEARLPORCH
PEARLPORCH.niche: beliefs Americans hold that real evidence flips — health myths, money myths, history myths, told as neighborhood gossip. STRICT: every correction must cite a real study, agency or record.
PEARLPORCH.style: warm gossipy storytelling with a twist reveal

BISONDESK.name: BISONDESK
BISONDESK.niche: absurd-but-TRUE turning points in American history — bizarre laws, accidental decisions, forgotten disasters. STRICT: real documented events only, with the year and the source institution.
BISONDESK.style: dry professorial deadpan over ridiculous facts

OWLOFFICE.name: OWLOFFICE
OWLOFFICE.niche: why everyday American systems work the way they do — tipping, health insurance, credit scores, jury duty, the electoral college. STRICT: explain the real mechanism and cite the real rule or agency.
OWLOFFICE.style: deadpan corporate explainer, unimpressed but precise
